item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will weaken slightly today. A southerly airstream will bring a few showers and thunderstorms to the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next couple of days, but it will remain very hot over the region. With the subtropical ridge extending westwards again, the weather will be persistently very hot over southeastern China during the weekend and early next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea to the seas east of the Philippines.
